privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body:
AMESCOTES, Inc. (the 'Company') protects users' personal data under the Personal Information Protection Act of Korea.

1. What we collect and why

To receive and answer inquiries, we collect company name, name, phone, email, preferred production site, expected quantity, inquiry type and message. We use them for no other purpose.

2. Retention

Kept for 3 years after the inquiry is closed, then deleted without delay, unless the law requires longer.

3. Third parties

We do not share personal data with third parties without consent.

4. Processors

Email delivery of inquiries: FormSubmit · Website hosting: GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.)

5. Your rights

You may request access, correction, deletion or suspension at any time at contact@amescotes.co.kr.

6. Contact

AMESCOTES, Inc. · contact@amescotes.co.kr

Effective 19 October 2026

vision.title: Vision & mission.
vision.vision: Everyone at Amescotes shares one vision: “Growing together with our partners.” We aim to shape the future of global accessory manufacturing through shared growth.
vision.mission: Built on our process experience and expertise, we create distinctive value for clients, so that partners and employees grow together and that growth feeds back into industry and culture.
values: One integrated process, managed directly across the entire production flow.
1:1 consulting for solutions that fit each brief and its conditions.
Run under our own Amescotes Standard Quality (ASQ).
Moving design, technology and business culture forward.

pps.title: PPS sampling.
pps.intro: Our stage-based PPS system checks design intent and structure at every step, cutting unnecessary sampling cost and time.
steps: Patterns are engineered in CAD, so revisions and grading move fast.
Size, proportion, silhouette and structure are checked in paper first.
Made in a similar material to fix texture such as wrinkles and slouch, plus the key details.
Made in the real material to confirm finish, material fit and production feasibility.
pps.old_note: Every change means another sample, so time and cost keep growing.
pps.new_note: Decisions are locked in paper and prototype, so the final sample lands in one go.

caps.title: Categories & capabilities.
caps.text: We only call it our range when we have made it ourselves, through trial and error. For each category we design and develop the core processes and details in-house.
cats: Custom goods, packaging and molded lifestyle items
caps.mtext: We design the processing method around each material’s character and physical properties, and keep extending it through new briefs and joint development with partners.

net.domestic: A close, independent network of Korean partners, from cutting houses we insist on for quality to process specialists for brands that want Korean production.
net.global: In 2025 we opened a 2,000 m² factory in Qingdao, China. It links production lines in Korea, China, Indonesia, Vietnam and Cambodia, with direct shipping to Japan, the US and Europe.
